p: Islington High Street is the short stretch running up to the Angel junction, one of north London's busiest corners, with the Tube station right there on the Northern line. This Admiral is an adult gaming centre, so it's 18+ only.

The area around it is a great place for a wander. Camden Passage, just behind the High Street, is a lane of antique shops, vintage dealers and little cafés with market stalls on certain days. Upper Street carries on north with restaurants, pubs and bars of every kind, and Chapel Market off Liverpool Road still runs as a proper London street market. If you've come for a show, Sadler's Wells dance theatre is a few minutes' walk south down Rosebery Avenue.
